title: "About"

## Project

This early warning system is developed by the **Chuang Lab at Taipei Medical University (TMU)**
as part of ongoing research into spatiotemporally-aware dengue fever prediction for Southeast Asia.

The system jointly models dengue dynamics across Taiwan and SEA by integrating:

- Monthly remote sensing data (ERA5-Land, MODIS, CHIRPS)
- OpenDengue surveillance records (2011–2018)
- CMIP6 climate projections (AR6, GWL scenarios)
- Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSP1-2.6 through SSP5-8.5)

## Methods

**Spatiotemporal Graph Attention Network (ST-GAT + GRU)**

Admin-1 regions are represented as nodes in a spatial graph. The model uses
two stacked Graph Attention layers for spatial message passing, followed by a
GRU to capture temporal dynamics across a sliding window of monthly observations.
Hyperparameters were selected via 40-trial Optuna sweeps using masked Huber loss
(to handle missing surveillance data).

**Climate bias correction**

A delta bias correction is applied to current observations before inference,
accounting for the distributional shift between the 2011–2018 training period
and present-day conditions. The per-variable, per-month delta is computed
as the difference between the current climatology and the 2011–2018 training
baseline. Predictions are expressed as a relative risk index rather than
absolute case counts.

## Data

| Source | Variables | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| ERA5-Land (ECMWF / GEE) | Precipitation, temperature, evaporation | ~9 km, monthly |
| MODIS MOD11A2 | Land surface temperature (day/night) | 1 km, 8-day → monthly |
| MODIS MOD13A3 | NDVI, EVI | 1 km, monthly |
| MODIS MCD12Q1 | Land use / land cover (17 classes) | 500 m, annual |
| WorldPop | Population density | 100 m, annual |
| OpenDengue | Dengue case counts | Admin-1, monthly |
